An Imperial Marshal carrying out secret missions.
A Marshal of the Empire who diligently strives to complete her assigned tasks to perfection. Though her overflowing confidence sometimes leads to mistakes, she holds her own firm sense of justice and unwavering convictions.​

manifestEgo.desc: Change the max stack count of <color_orange>Form Upgrade</> for the <color_orange><u>Event Horizon</u></> card from <color_orange>3</> to <color_orange>4</>.
manifestEgo.title: Sleeping Memory

manifestEgo.desc:
When an Archetype card is activated, gain that card’s shape effect.
When shape effects stack to 3, create 1 card consisting of the stacked shape effects.
○: Heal 150%
△: Increase Damage Amount of the first Hit of the next Attack Card by 30% (max 300%)
□: Draw 1 Archetype card
This effect can only be activated once per turn, and the shape effect is removed at the end of the turn once it is activated.
manifestEgo.title: Awakening Memory

manifestEgo.desc: Increase the additional creation count of <color_orange><u>Archetype Resonance</u></> to <color_orange>3</> times, and increase the Cost decrease effect of the next $Ego Skill$ used to <color_orange>3</>.
manifestEgo.title: Vivid Memory

manifestEgo.desc:
When Tiphera's Archetype card is $activate$d, gain the Power of Archetype effect.
Power of Archetype: Increase Damage Amount of Attack Cards of allies by 5%, increase Order Attribute Damage Amount of allies by 5%, and increase Defense-Based Damage Amount of allies by 5%
At the end of the turn, remove Power of Archetype (max 2 stacks)
manifestEgo.title: Inner Memory

manifestEgo.desc: Increase the level of <color_orange>[Basic Card Upgrade]</>, <color_orange>[Signature Card Upgrade]</>, and <color_orange>[Common Card Upgrade]</> in Potentials by <color_orange>3</>.
manifestEgo.title: Complete Memory

manifestEgo.desc:
Tiphera's Signature Cards receive Damage Amount Increase effects gained from Archetype: △ cards, but are changed to not be consumed.
At the start of battle, change Archetype: △’s Damage Amount effect to increase from 30% to 35%, and max stacks from 300% to 350%.
manifestEgo.title: Liberated Memory
